tui.bridge_card.frame.untrusted.note: Framing line shown directly above an inbound Team Bridge message body in the terminal transcript. The body below it is text written by another person or agent and is NOT vetted: the line must read as a caution, not as an endorsement. Keep 'untrusted' strong.

tui.bridge_card.body.loading.note: Shown in an expanded inbound Team Bridge card while its message body is being fetched (local store or Radient).

tui.bridge_card.body.pending.note: The message passed screening but your agent has not been handed it yet (its turn has not run). Not an error.

tui.bridge_card.body.held.note: The message was held by the operator's content screening and not shown to the agent. Never mention a reason or category; only that it is held.

tui.bridge_card.body.refused.note: Radient's moderation rejected this message for the agent. Never mention a reason or category; only that it was refused.

tui.bridge_card.body.not_admitted.note: This message was not admitted to the agent (it was never handed to it). Distinct from held/refused: no moderation decision is implied.

tui.bridge_card.body.unavailable.note: Generic fallback when the body cannot be shown for a reason without its own sentence.

tui.bridge_card.body.signed_out.note: The body can only be shown while signed in to Radient (the product name 'Radient' is not translated).

tui.bridge_card.body.other_account.note: The card arrived while a different Radient account was signed in, so its body is not shown to the current account. 'Radient' is a product name.

tui.bridge_card.body.not_member.note: Radient refused the read because the viewer is no longer a member of the conversation.

tui.bridge_card.body.offline.note: Network/hub failure while fetching the body. 'Expand' refers to opening the card again (Enter/click). 'Radient' is a product name.

tui.bridge_card.body.show_more.note: Last row of a long inbound message clamped to its first lines. {shown} is the number of lines shown (a plain number), {total} the total line count. 'm' is the literal keyboard key and must stay the letter m.

tui.bridge_card.body.show_less.note: Last row of a fully expanded long inbound message; pressing the literal key 'm' clamps it again. Keep 'm' as the letter m.

tui.bridge_card.body.more_messages.note: A coalesced card groups several messages; only the first ones are shown. {count} is how many more are not shown here.
